en: A black-and-white image depicting a grand baroque-style palace with an ornate facade, set in formal gardens. In the foreground, there is a dramatic statue of a winged male figure (possibly an angel or mythical figure) carrying a woman, with a child at the base. The garden is well maintained with flowerbeds, and a few people are visible near the palace entrance. The photo shows signs of aging, such as stains and worn corners, suggesting it is an old postcard.
